university: Tunku Abdul Rahman University of Management and Technology

fees.notes: TAR UMT official programme page lists RM76,600 as the total international fee for the full programme (inclusive of 6% SST; covers all fees payable to TAR UMT, excluding EMGS and immigration charges; the page states fees may vary by 10%). Source: https://fafb.tarc.edu.my/programmes/bachelors-degree/commerce (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: (1) STPM - Minimum Grade C+ in 2 relevant subjects (2) A Level - Minimum Grade D in 2 relevant subjects (3) UEC - Grade B in 5 relevant subjects (4) Other IHL - Relevant Foundation (with minimum CGPA 2.5000)/ Diploma (with minimum CGPA 2.5000) accredited by MQA (5) TAR UC - Foundation in Accounting with minimum CGPA 2.5000 OR Relevant Diploma with minimum CGPA 2.5000 Compulsory subjects: (1), (2), (3) and (4) must include - i) SPM Credit/ O Level Grade C in Mathematics/ UEC Grade B in one mathematics subject ii) SPM Pass/ O Level Grade E (Pass)/ UEC Grade C in English Language (1) - (5) must include MUET Band 2 or replaced with IELTS Band Score 4.0 or Equivalent***  *** Exempted for students whose programme full medium of instruction was in English. Note: a) Students without a credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu are required to pass Bahasa Kebangsaan A before the award of Bachelor Degree. b) TAR UC Diploma will be accepted on credit transfer into Bachelor Degree programmes. c) Equivalent qualifications/qualifications from other Institution of Higher Learning (IHL) will be considered on a case-by-case basis. d) Subject to the Ministry of Higher Education latest requirements.
